metadata.title: fix: Fix playwright gateway action tests

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

## 📌 Summary
Closes #3982

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps
1. Run the playwright tests

## 🐞 Root Cause
The playwright test updates got lost on a PR rework.

## 💡 Fix Description
Added a step to open the overflow menu to the gateway action tests

reviews.author: marekdano
reviews.body:
The test `tests/playwright/test_gateways.py::TestGatewayActions::test_gateway_row_actions_visible` fails with the error
```bash 
 def test_gateway_row_actions_visible(self, gateways_page: GatewaysPage):
        """Test that all gateway row action buttons are visible."""
        gateways_page.navigate_to_gateways_tab()
        gateways_page.wait_for_gateways_table_loaded()

        # Skip if no gateways exist
        if gateways_page.get_gateway_count() == 0:
            pytest.skip("No gateways available for testing")

        # Get first gateway row
        first_row = gateways_page.get_gateway_row(0)

        # Verify all action buttons exist
>       expect(first_row.locator('button:has-text("Test")')).to_be_visible()
E       AssertionError: Locator expected to be visible
E       Actual value: hidden
E       Call log:
E         - Expect "to_be_visible" with timeout 5000ms
E         - waiting for locator("#gateways-table-body").locator("tr").first.locator("button:has-text(\"Test\")")
E           9 × locator resolved to <button type="button" role="menuitem" @click="menuOpen = false; testGateway("http://fast_time_server:8080/sse")" class="w-full flex items-center px-4 py-2 text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700">Test</button>
E             - unexpected value "hidden"

tests/playwright/test_gateways.py:528: AssertionError
```

The test is failing because the action buttons (Test, View, Edit, etc.) are inside a dropdown menu that is hidden by default. According to PR #3802 mentioned in the page object, all action buttons were moved inside an Alpine.js-controlled dropdown with menuOpen: false by default.

To fix this error, the `test_gateway_row_actions_visible` test  should be updated with 
```bash
# Open the action dropdown (PR #3802 moved buttons inside dropdown)
gateways_page._open_action_dropdown(first_row)

# Verify all action buttons exist in the dropdown menu
expect(first_row.locator('button[role="menuitem"]:has-text("Test")')).to_be_visible()
expect(first_row.locator('button[role="menuitem"]:has-text("View")')).to_be_visible()
expect(first_row.locator('button[role="menuitem"]:has-text("Edit")')).to_be_visible()

# Either Activate or Deactivate should be visible
activate_btn = first_row.locator('button[role="menuitem"]:text-is("Activate")')
deactivate_btn = first_row.locator('button[role="menuitem"]:text-is("Deactivate")')
assert activate_btn.is_visible() or deactivate_btn.is_visible()

# Delete button should be visible (inside a form)
expect(first_row.locator('form[action*="/delete"] button[type="submit"]:has-text("Delete")')).to_be_visible()
```

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
Looks good, nice catch on the regression from PR #3802.

I rebased onto main (clean, no conflicts) and added two follow-up commits:

**Commit 2** — `fix: add missing _open_action_dropdown call in delete_gateway_by_url`
- `delete_gateway_by_url()` was the one action method in the page object that was missed — it also clicks the Delete button which lives inside the dropdown now. Added the `_open_action_dropdown` call + black/isort formatting cleanup.

**Commit 3** — `fix: open action dropdown in remaining test files that bypass page object`
- Three other test files click gateway action buttons directly (bypassing the page object), so they were broken by the same #3802 change:
  - `test_rbac_permissions.py` — `test_admin_delete_gateway` located the delete button on the row directly
  - `test_admin_url_context.py` — `_get_delete_gateway_btn` helper used by multiple URL-context and iframe delete tests
  - `test_iframe_embedding_security.py` — delete and toggle iframe tests operated on `FrameLocator` directly
- Each now opens the actions dropdown before clicking. Added `wait_for(state="attached")` guards in the iframe tests and moved the skip guard before the dropdown interaction in `_get_delete_gateway_btn`.

Selectors verified against `gateways_partial.html` — all match (`button[aria-expanded]`, `[role="menu"]`, `button[role="menuitem"]`, `form[action*="/delete"]`).

commits.message:
fix: add missing _open_action_dropdown call in delete_gateway_by_url

The delete_gateway_by_url method was missing the _open_action_dropdown
call added by the previous commit. Since PR #3802 moved all action
buttons (including Delete) inside an Alpine.js dropdown menu, the
delete button is not directly clickable without first opening the menu.

Closes #3982

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: open action dropdown in remaining test files that bypass page object

Three test files directly click gateway action buttons without going
through the GatewaysPage page object, so they were also broken by
PR #3802's move to the Alpine.js overflow menu:

- test_rbac_permissions.py: test_admin_delete_gateway bypassed page
  object to inspect HTTP response status directly
- test_admin_url_context.py: _get_delete_gateway_btn helper used by
  multiple URL-context tests and iframe delete tests
- test_iframe_embedding_security.py: delete and toggle tests operated
  directly on iframe FrameLocator

Each now opens the actions dropdown before clicking the menu item.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
